name: AlpacaEval
intro: AlpacaEval 使用固定的805条指令，将被测模型回复与 text-davinci-003 参考回复随机排序后交给 GPT-4 自动裁判成对比较，并以平局计0.5的方式报告平均胜率与标准误。
build_method: AlpacaFarm评测集简化, text-davinci-003参考重生成, GPT-4成对自动评审
task_type: 开放式对话, 偏好评测
eval_feature: 成对偏好, LLM-as-Judge, 回复顺序随机化, 平局计0.5, 平均胜率与标准误
build_method_en: AlpacaFarm evaluation-set simplification, text-davinci-003 reference regeneration, GPT-4 pairwise automatic judging
eval_feature_en: Pairwise preference, LLM-as-Judge, response-order randomization, tie handling
intro_en: AlpacaEval uses a fixed set of 805 instructions, randomizes each evaluated-model response against its text-davinci-003 reference for GPT-4 pairwise judging, assigns 0.5 to ties, and reports mean win rate with standard error.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official tatsu-lab/alpaca_eval repository at revision cd543a149df89434d8a54582c0151c0b945c3d20, especially README.md Data Release, Differences with AlpacaFarm, Win Rate, and src/alpaca_eval/evaluators_configs/alpaca_eval_gpt4. The original benchmark starts from the fixed 805-example AlpacaFarm evaluation set, merges instruction and input for the one-quarter Self-Instruct subset, regenerates text-davinci-003 references without the prior length limit, randomizes candidate/reference order, runs alpaca_eval_gpt4 at temperature zero, assigns 0.5 to ties, and reports mean win rate with standard error. arXiv:2404.04475 describes the later length-controlled metric and is deliberately not used as the original AlpacaEval construction source.
